## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who is the target user?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the desired behavior and how it should work.

## Alternatives Considered

What alternatives have you considered and why weren't they suitable?

## Affected Components

- [ ] Agent Ops (MCP tools, gRPC)
- [ ] Terraform (new modules / providers)
- [ ] Kubernetes (manifests / overlays)
- [ ] FinOps (cost analysis / budgets / forecasts)
- [ ] Configuration (TOML / schemas)
- [ ] Architecture (ADR required)
- [ ] CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
- [ ] Data Mesh (vectorization / stores)

## ADR Required?

- [ ] Yes — I will create or link an ADR
- [ ] No — purely additive, no architectural change

## Additional Context

Links to related PRs, issues, or external references.
